t: This is where Kilburn Grammar School once stood. It opened in 1898 in Kilburn, in north-west London, and ceased to exist in 1967. The school was founded by the Reverend Henry George Bonavia Hunt, an Anglican cleric who lived from 1847 to 1917. Hunt is also remembered as the founder of the Trinity College of Music in London, so he was a man with an interest in education and music. Here, it is his school that matters, which served the area for nearly seventy years.
